semantics.audio: float32 interleaved finite [-1,1], sample_count across all channels
semantics.routing: zero-based channel copy; repeated indices duplicate; unique output IDs
semantics.time: host monotonic ns; origin=now+positive lead; block=origin+floor(frame*1e9/rate)
semantics.epoch: fixed after start; initial frame 0; strictly contiguous
semantics.memory: input not retained; enqueue samples borrowed until callback return; callbacks/user alive through destroy; last_error borrowed until next modifying call/destroy
semantics.threading: serialized; callbacks no reentry/throw; C exceptions contained; not real-time safe
semantics.prepare_failure: close all attempted outputs including failing output; return Idle
semantics.input_rejection: no enqueue; preserve Running and next_frame
semantics.backpressure: any enqueue failure including WouldBlock closes all outputs/Faulted; no retry; no physical atomicity
semantics.stop: idempotent; close active outputs; Idle/reset time; C configured bindings retained
semantics.destroy: null safe; closes before user/callbacks may be released
semantics.success: backend acceptance, not acoustic playback or measured sync
